parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 3 - Bleach Update

Overview

Trickster is a MythicalMythical Limited unit. He is only obtainable through summons during Hollow World event.

Trickster can evolve into Trickster (Release) with the following materials:

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Trivia

  • Trickster was the first limited mythical unit added to the game that can be obtained via summoning on the banner, and can evolve into a evolved secret unit.
